description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Process Calculations (Material and Energy Balances) topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: process-calculations

facts.claim: Derived units come from the base quantities (e.g. speed, energy, pressure)

source.quote: Derived units are the units of the quantities that are derived from the base quantities

facts.claim: Mole fractions in a mixture add up to 1

source.quote: The sum of all the mole fractions in a mixture is equal to 1

facts.claim: Mole fraction is amount/amount; molarity is amount/volume

source.quote: molar concentration is a quotient of amount to volume (in units of moles per litre)
The ideal gas law, also called the general gas equation, is the equation of state of a hypothetical ideal gas

facts.claim: A mass balance applies conservation of mass

source.quote: a mass balance, also called a material balance, is an application of conservation of mass

facts.claim: At steady state the accumulation term is zero

source.quote: Mass balances can be simplified with the assumption of steady state, in which the accumulation term is zero

facts.claim: Stoichiometry relates amounts of reactants and products (mass conserved)

source.quote: Stoichiometry ( ) is the relationships between the quantities of reactants and products before, during and after chemical reactions

facts.claim: With air, the nitrogen passes through unreacted into the flue gas

source.quote: the nitrogen present in the air (Atmosphere of Earth) can be added to the equation

facts.claim: Without reaction, each species flowing in equals that flowing out at steady state

source.quote: In the absence of a chemical reaction the amount of any chemical species flowing in and out will be the same

facts.claim: Vapour pressure: pressure of vapour in equilibrium with its liquid at a given temperature

source.quote: Vapor pressure or equilibrium vapor pressure is the pressure exerted by a vapor in thermodynamic equilibrium with its condensed phases

facts.claim: Relative humidity compares actual moisture with saturation at that temperature

source.quote: Relative humidity, often expressed as a percentage, indicates a present state of absolute humidity relative to a maximum humidity

facts.claim: Warmer air holds more water vapour before saturating

source.quote: The amount of water vapor needed to achieve saturation increases as the temperature increases

facts.claim: Crystals nucleate and grow from a supersaturated solution

source.quote: the appearance of a crystalline phase from either a supercooled liquid or a supersaturated solvent

facts.claim: Heat capacity: heat needed per unit temperature rise (J/K)

source.quote: defined as the amount of heat that must be supplied to an object to produce a unit change in its temperature

facts.claim: ΔH°rxn = Σ products − Σ reactants (standard states)

source.quote: is the difference between total product and total reactant molar enthalpies, calculated for substances in their standard states
